description.en_US: Stock ActiveWindow indexes the monitors array by Hyprland monitor ID, which breaks whenever IDs stop matching array positions (e.g. after switching from the internal panel to an external monitor) — the bar then shows 'Workspace N' instead of the focused window's title. This module overrides the binding with an id-based lookup via an inserted Binding{}. Self-retiring once upstream fixes the line.
description.zh_TW: stock 的 ActiveWindow 拿 Hyprland monitor ID 當陣列索引，ID 與陣列位置不一致時（例如從內建螢幕換到外接螢幕）標題區只會顯示「Workspace N」。本模塊插入 Binding{} 以 id 查找覆蓋錯誤綁定；上游修復後錨點消失、模塊自動退場。

description.en_US: Long-term battery history and analytics — with zero bar footprint by default (the stock bar already has a battery gauge). Sampling runs invisibly; the detail panel opens from a sidebar quick-toggle tile (Tier B patch) or IPC: 24 h curve (charge segments tinted, suspend gaps annotated), 30-day daily min/max bands, a year of health snapshots, drain-rate/cycle statistics and charge-session records, plus a hover popup with smoothed power draw and a regression-based time estimate. Optional opt-in bar pill: 3 h sparkline (percentage text a further opt-in). Tiered retention (24 h raw / 30 d hourly / 365 d daily) keeps the history file bounded. Native data sources only: UPower service + sysfs reads.
description.zh_TW: 手機級的長期電量趨勢與分析——預設零 bar 佔位（stock bar 已有電池指示器）。取樣在背景進行；詳情面板由側欄快速開關磁貼（Tier B 補丁）或 IPC 開啟——24 小時曲線（充電段上色、休眠斷點標註）、30 天每日最高/最低區間、一年健康快照、耗電速率/循環統計與充放電段記錄，另有 hover 彈窗顯示平滑功耗與回歸法剩餘時間估計（與 UPower 對照）。可選開啟 bar 藥丸：3 小時迷你曲線（百分比文字再另行選開）。分層保留（原始 24 小時／小時級 30 天／日級 365 天）讓歷史檔案大小有界。純原生資料來源：UPower 服務＋sysfs 檔案讀取。
description.zh_CN: 手机级的长期电量趋势与分析——默认零 bar 占位（stock bar 已有电池指示器）。采样在后台进行；详情面板由侧栏快速开关磁贴（Tier B 补丁）或 IPC 打开——24 小时曲线（充电段上色、休眠断点标注）、30 天每日最高/最低区间、一年健康快照、耗电速率/循环统计与充放电段记录，另有悬停弹窗显示平滑功耗与回归法剩余时间估计（与 UPower 对照）。可选开启 bar 药丸：3 小时迷你曲线（百分比文字再另行选开）。分层保留（原始 24 小时／小时级 30 天／日级 365 天）让历史文件大小有界。纯原生数据来源：UPower 服务＋sysfs 文件读取。

description.en_US: Shrinks the clock widget's hover popup to a single date line by hiding the system-uptime row and the To-Do section. Disable the module to get the full popup back.
description.zh_TW: 把時鐘的 hover 彈窗縮成一行日期：隱藏 system uptime 列與 To Do 區塊。停用本模塊即可還原完整彈窗。

description.en_US: Right-click the bar's WiFi / Bluetooth indicator icons to open the module's own QML panels: a multi-adapter networks list (own nmcli parsing — every wifi adapter gets its own section, plus bluetooth-tethered PAN/NAP and ethernet sections) with connect + inline password + inline error, and a Bluetooth devices panel with pair/connect/forget (Quickshell's native Bluetooth service). No external tools.
description.zh_TW: 右鍵 bar 上的 WiFi／藍牙指示圖示，開啟模塊自製的 QML 面板：多介面卡網路列表（自行解析 nmcli——每張 WiFi 網卡各自成段，外加藍牙網路共享 PAN/NAP 與乙太網路分段）＋連線＋行內密碼＋行內錯誤訊息、藍牙裝置面板配對/連線/移除（Quickshell 原生 Bluetooth 服務）。不依賴外部工具。

description.en_US: Visual RAM/swap viewer and cleaner: pressure-coloured bar percentage widget (hideable to save bar space), hover popup with an honest composition mini-bar (in use / reclaimable cache / free always sum to MemTotal), and a panel with an animated composition bar, treemap-style top-process blocks (area = RSS, double-click your own to SIGTERM), swap compaction (swapoff+swapon) and cache dropping (drop_caches) behind a polkit/sudo auth prompt with a measured freed delta. Optional sidebar quick-toggle tile (Tier B patch) opens the panel.
description.zh_TW: 視覺化 RAM/swap 檢視與清理工具：壓力變色百分比 bar 元件（可隱藏以節省 bar 空間）、hover 彈窗含誠實的組成迷你條（應用程式／可回收快取／可用，總和恆等於 MemTotal）、詳細面板——動畫組成條、treemap 式程序方塊（面積＝RSS，點兩下可結束自己的程序）、整理 swap 與清除快取（polkit/sudo 認證後執行並回報實測釋放量）。可選側欄快速開關磁貼（Tier B 補丁），點擊開啟面板。
description.zh_CN: 可视化 RAM/swap 查看与清理工具：压力变色百分比 bar 组件（可隐藏以节省 bar 空间）、悬停弹窗含诚实的组成迷你条（应用程序／可回收缓存／可用，总和恒等于 MemTotal）、详细面板——动画组成条、treemap 式进程方块（面积＝RSS，双击可结束自己的进程）、整理 swap 与清除缓存（polkit/sudo 认证后执行并回报实测释放量）。可选侧栏快速开关磁贴（Tier B 补丁），点击打开面板。

system.hint: procps-ng — top-process sampling in the panel
polkit — auth prompt for the swap/cache cleanup actions

description.en_US: Up/down bandwidth meter for the bar: live rates, DNS ping, boot/today/month totals (whole-system and per-app), Bezier trend graphs with dynamic scale, and a per-app usage ranking (continuous nethogs accounting) in the hover popup. Reads /proc/net/dev; tunnel and container interfaces are excluded by default so VPN traffic is not double-counted.
description.zh_TW: Bar 上下行流量計：即時速率、DNS ping、開機/本日/本月累計（全系統與 per-app）、動態刻度貝茲趨勢曲線、hover 彈窗含 per-app 佔用排行（nethogs 常駐統計）。預設排除隧道/容器介面，VPN 不重複計算。窄螢幕自動改用雙行緊湊版面。

system.hint: sudo pacman -S nethogs  # per-app usage in the popup; for rootless capture: sudo setcap 'cap_net_admin,cap_net_raw,cap_dac_read_search,cap_sys_ptrace+ep' /usr/bin/nethogs

description.en_US: Phone-style screen time tracking. Focus accounting via Quickshell's native ToplevelManager (event-driven, pauses while locked, suspend gaps not counted): today's per-app seconds, hourly histogram, and a 30-day daily history. A separate 'AI work time' dimension samples the CPU of agent process trees (claude/codex by default) every 10s and counts sessions actually working — even unfocused or locked — with parallel-session peak and sum. Bar pill with today's total and a hover popup (top apps, yesterday comparison, AI work time); detail panel via IPC with hourly/7-day/30-day charts, per-app ranking, and an AI section; optional sidebar quick-toggle tile (Tier B patch) that opens the detail panel.
description.zh_TW: 手機風格的螢幕使用時間統計。以 Quickshell 原生 ToplevelManager 做焦點記帳（事件驅動、鎖屏暫停、休眠時段不入帳）：今日各應用秒數、每小時直方圖、30 天每日歷史。另有獨立的「AI 工作時長」維度：每 10 秒取樣 agent 程序樹（預設 claude/codex）的 CPU，統計真正在工作的 session——即使未聚焦甚至鎖屏——含並行峰值與合計。Bar 藥丸顯示今日總時長，hover 彈窗含 Top 應用、昨日比較與 AI 工作時長；IPC 開啟詳情面板（時段/7 天/30 天圖表、應用排行與 AI 區塊）；可選側欄快速開關磁貼（Tier B 補丁），點擊開啟詳情面板。
